name: Sequential Filter Expansion Inventory
description: Declarative refinement inventory for generic sequential filter pipelines.

operations.name: Insert Observability Check
operations.dejargonized_summary: Check whether the filter has enough observations to estimate the state.

rewrite.after_summary: An observability check is inserted before prediction.
rewrite.information_flow_effect: Adds state-identifiability evidence before propagating the filter.

operations.name: Insert Innovation Whiteness Check
operations.dejargonized_summary: Check whether update residuals still contain structure the model missed.

rewrite.before_summary: Updates flow downstream without innovation whiteness evidence.
rewrite.after_summary: An innovation-whiteness check is inserted after update.
rewrite.information_flow_effect: Adds residual-correlation evidence for model mismatch.

operations.name: Insert Adaptive Noise Estimation
operations.dejargonized_summary: Adapt process or observation noise when fixed noise assumptions are unstable.

rewrite.before_summary: Prediction covariance uses fixed noise assumptions.
rewrite.after_summary: An adaptive-noise estimation stage is inserted before covariance prediction.
rewrite.information_flow_effect: Adds residual-driven noise adaptation evidence before covariance propagation.

operations.name: Insert Divergence Detection
operations.dejargonized_summary: Detect when sequential state updates are diverging.

rewrite.before_summary: Filter updates flow downstream without NIS divergence evidence.
rewrite.after_summary: A divergence detector is inserted after update.
rewrite.information_flow_effect: Adds statistical divergence evidence before trusting state estimates.

audit.rationale: Moves existing sequential filter expansion rules onto the common provider expansion schema.
audit.dejargonized_summary: Reusable checks for observability, innovation whiteness, adaptive noise, and divergence.
